roles.title: Senior Software Engineer, Data Sharing & Discovery
description: After a roughly 1.5-year stint in Operational Intelligence, I am back to building the Ingka Data Platform — now as a software engineer. A major internal reorganization split our previous domain into two: Platform Engineering (where I am now), and Technology Services (where Operational Intelligence went). My current focus is making data accessible, discoverable, and shareable across all of IKEA by designing and developing solutions for data products.

roles.title: Product Owner, Operational Intelligence
description: Product Owner for two teams responsible for synthetic monitoring and software observability capabilities underpinning critical customer flows across IKEA.com and in-store experiences. Collaborated closely with software engineers during IKEA's migration from Akamai to Cloudflare. Established ways of working aligned with Ingka's product management strategy. Defined OKRs and product taxonomy.
cvDescription: Product Owner for two teams, responsible for synthetic monitoring and software observability capabilities that underpin critical customer flows across IKEA.com and in-store experiences. Active participant in all leadership meetings across the Operational Intelligence area.

Collaborated closely with software engineers during IKEA's migration from Akamai to Cloudflare, developing new observability capabilities and ensuring continuity across critical systems. Took a hands-on approach to understand technical constraints while maintaining focus on customer outcomes.

Established ways of working aligned with Ingka's product management strategy, including the setup of Jira projects and cross-team agile practices. Conducted user research across multiple business areas to develop deep customer empathy and translate insights into product and platform strategy. Defined OKRs and product taxonomy, communicating vision to key stakeholders to gain buy-in for capability investments.

roles.title: Product Owner, Data Enablement Technology
description: Defined the product vision and initiated a centralized data platform from the ground up, recruiting the founding engineering team. What started as one team has since grown into multiple teams covering data governance, quality, and product development — forming the foundation of IKEA's modernized data infrastructure.
cvDescription: Defined the product vision and initiated a centralized data platform from the ground up, recruiting the founding engineering team and establishing the roadmap for capabilities spanning metadata management, data discovery, and self-service data access.

Served as the product counterpart to engineers and architects, partnering closely with Enterprise Architecture and Data Architecture leadership to make informed trade-offs between technical constraints and user needs.

Drove collaboration and established agile methodologies across multiple teams, creating shared practices, tooling, and documentation that enabled the platform to scale. Guided and supported team members to perform to the best of their ability while fostering a continuous improvement mindset. What started as one team has since grown into multiple teams covering data governance, data quality, and data product development, forming the foundation of IKEA's modernized data infrastructure.

roles.title: Head of Data & Product Owner, Internal Tools
description: Built and led a Data team responsible for data warehousing, BI, and internal tooling. Created an in-house CRM and BI platform. Stack: PostgreSQL, TimescaleDB, Kafka, Python, Go.
cvDescription: Built and led the Data team responsible for UpCloud's data warehousing, business intelligence, and internal tooling. Created an in-house CRM and BI platform that enabled data-informed decision making across teams regardless of technical background.

Developed data models, APIs, and automated workflows integrating with services including Google Analytics, HubSpot, Intercom, Segment, and Tableau. Stack centered on PostgreSQL, TimescaleDB, Kafka, Python, and Golang.

roles.title: Head of Marketing
description: Led a complete brand overhaul. Directed the redesign of UpCloud.com, centering community tutorials and open-source contributions. Developed a data-informed advertising strategy executed entirely in-house. Achieved positive ROI with a small team.
cvDescription: Led a complete brand overhaul in collaboration with Kallan & Co, defining UpCloud's mission, vision, and visual identity from logo to tone of voice.

Directed the redesign of UpCloud.com with GrandWorks.co, centering the community's tutorials, open-source contributions, and user stories. This became the primary driver of organic traffic and revenue growth.

Developed a data-informed advertising strategy executed entirely in-house after external consultants failed to deliver. Achieved positive ROI with a small team through continuous improvement of data quality and processes.

roles.title: Founder & Product Manager
description: Took Cloud Royale from idea to launched product with a small team. Owned brand strategy, led engineering, and drove sales and marketing.
cvDescription: Took Cloud Royale from idea to launched product with a small team. Owned brand strategy, led engineering projects, and drove sales and marketing. Used A/B testing and customer feedback to iterate toward a simple, flexible cloud platform.

roles.title: Head of Shared Hosting
description: Responsible for customer service, development, marketing, and reselling. Launched a reseller program that sustained growth beyond my tenure.

description: Managed product development — packaging, pricing, research — and marketing execution against roadmap.
cvDescription: Managed product development (packaging, pricing, research) and marketing execution against roadmap. Part of the team that relaunched the company website.
